organisation.name: NovaPay Fintech Ltd
organisation.nature_of_business: Simulated digital banking and instant payment platform offering multi-account wallet management, peer-to-peer transfers, deposits, withdrawals, transaction reversals, and compliance auditing.

database_users.purpose: View balances, initiate P2P transfers, fund wallets, withdraw funds, inspect transaction receipts.
Monitor failed settlements, process authorised transaction reversals, reconcile daily ledger totals.
Audit immutable ledger records, inspect high-risk transfer alerts, investigate anomalous device/session events.
Manage schemas, tune indexes, enforce transaction isolation, configure partitioning, replication, and backups.

major_data_stored: Financial accounts, account types, balances, and account statuses
Transfers, deposits, withdrawals, and reversal links
Immutable double-entry ledger postings (debit/credit journal entries)
Idempotency records, audit logs, and semi-structured fraud/telemetry events (NoSQL)
key_operations: Onboard customers and provision typed financial accounts with KYC limits
Execute atomic peer-to-peer fund transfers with double-entry ledger postings
Process deposits, withdrawals, and full/partial reversals of failed transactions
Generate paginated account statements and monthly reconciliation reports
Audit high-value/flagged transactions and detect concurrent race conditions (double-spend prevention)
